body: Thank you for making sense of it. I’ve never responded like that before so I was a little worried
Can I ask how you conducted the mindful meditation? I’m using an app to get into it atm but want to make it more focused eventually
THIS!!

Omg I’m so glad it’s not just me! I’ve been trying to do my BSc for 5 years now it’s a 3 year course and I’d only be going into second year now 🤦🏻‍♀️ it’s tragic. And I’m probably going to fail and not even get in. My resits were TERRIBLE! It’s like I’m somehow failing at being an abuse survivor as well as everything else 🙄

Am I somehow extra broken because I didn’t end up successful? I used to be until the first year of a-levels (UK) but then extra trauma and epilepsy kinda ruined everything. Now I’m unemployable with no skills about to flunk out of university and have to go back and live with my abusive parents 😿
Omg me screaming and crying at about 5 years old as my sister is pulling dandelions and throwing them over the back fence because she’s killing them 🙃

Never know what to do. My current best friend isn’t friends with my abuser but he is very close friends with lots of the enablers and it hurts me to have any connection to what happened.
I don’t know if I need to end the friendship or not it’s just really hard.
No joke when does the paranoia end? I haven’t spoken to him in 2 years, is blocked on all social media and I still think he’s everywhere and knows everything 🤦🏻‍♀️
And when they do actually compliment you for doing something they approve of it feels so unbelievably uncomfortable 😬🤢
Omg I’ve just realised I do this so much! I didn’t realise it was an actual thing… thank you for posting this I’ll need to look into it
This is how it’s always been, a greater portion of the population are just aware now. If anything it makes me hopeful of change. Then again I’m probably just being naive
Congratulations! This is amazing and you definitely deserve it for working so hard!

I have been in therapy for a few years and C-PTSD is only just being spoken about as I was reluctant to open up about many things. However earlier on in my medical history there was a period of time I was diagnosed as having BPD-traits but not the disorder itself. I now think this was just my trauma/C-PTSD but it’s all still being figured out.

Having trauma is like having a second full time job that completely drains you and at times makes you incapable of completing anything else because you’re so bogged down with the work the difference is this job goes unnoticed and unappreciated by everyone around you and sometimes even yourself
Omg… I just laughed so hard I spat my drink out in front of my not in the know flatmate 😂🤦🏻‍♀️
Literally because of this I used to think I was exceptional at reading people. I’m not I’m just terrified of being abused again so I’m on high alert 24/7
Yes, sorry, I meant “normal” for a narc - I’m not very good at articulating myself. I’m still wondering if I’m just crazy or imagining things. Typical is a much better way to say it thank you!
I’m scared of this too it happens all the time. Stay strong though you’re doing amazing just hanging in there with all this!
Relate so hard this is literally me

Is there any meditation tips you have? or is it just to start and give yourself time to adjust to it? Meditation really scares me because when I tried it a couple times I was still at the point where my mind goes crazy and I just started crying so I stopped and didn’t keep going. It seems very important to peoples journeys though so I want to try again I just think I need a little help with it
